method: Isolated sandbox without .git/sibling repo, patches P2+P1+P3. failingWithP1: tests PASS today that become ERROR (SalUndefinedInputError) with P1 default error mode; firstUndefined is only the first missing key. undefinedReads: every distinct key read without a value per test-file process, measured with a record-mode variant returning the legacy value (FALSE; unconnected TRUE).

kinds.global: global-variable reference whose variable no executed block writes
kinds.alias: alias-device/link variable not set (physical/PLC input or producer outside the executed cut)
kinds.wire: direct wire from a block outside the executed cut, not seeded

howToResolve: Per test: establish the value in the scenario (setInputs / values.set on the cut wire) when the requirement defines it; otherwise declare it via new SalRuntime(model,{assumedInputs:{name:false}}) (visible as runtime.declaredAssumptions) or, for capability scans only, undefinedInputs:"record" and assert/publish runtime.undefinedInputReads. Unbound ports require an explicit unconnectedInput Boolean.
